fixtureBoundary: The runner bootstrap creates an isolated owned property.
Direct state setup is used only to establish repeatable full-shelf and nine-box visual/performance fixtures.
Laptop entry, box cutting, flap opening, product removal, carrying, and shelf stocking use trusted mouse/keyboard input.

screenshots.description: Existing laptop Orders view reached with normal player input.
Nine simultaneous delivery boxes at the fixed receiving camera.
Sealed hero case and automatically equipped cutter from player camera.
Opened carton with current visible product contents.
Product armful carried from the opened carton.
Compatible shelf after normal-control partial stocking.

inputActions.description: open Orders on the physical laptop
cut the carton tape along the interaction seam
take a product armful from the opened box
stock the compatible ball display one unit at a time
